title: Separate tenant smoke from compat Core Smoke and provision a real multi-mode CI job
goal: Dispose of the diagnosed Core Smoke signal mismatch by keeping compat-mode core coverage explicit and giving the tenant hostile specs a dedicated CI path with multi mode, tenants 101/202, memberships, and dictionary fixtures.
statusNote: 2026-09-22: disposition implemented. Core Smoke now uses an explicit 9-spec compat-mode allowlist, so tenant specs cannot enter without their preconditions. A separate push-only advisory Tenant Smoke job provisions MySQL/Redis, runs tenantmatrixdb in explicit multi mode (tenants 101/202 plus memberships), rehydrates matrix_browser_a/_b fixtures, executes all three hostile tenant specs, uploads failures, and restores the database. README/glob drift is closed. Local multi-mode execution remains an external CI validation gap because this workstation has no MySQL service; no production evidence is claimed.
technicalDebtNote: The tenant specs were placed in tests/smoke-core/, whose glob is executed only by the push-to-main advisory job that provisions no tenant mode and no fixtures; the suite README still lists 8 files and does not mention them. The signal has therefore been red and unrunnable-in-practice since the specs landed, and no PR-path gate covers them.
